turns.user: Does BART have wheelchair access at every station?
turns.message:
Yes — every BART station has an elevator, and all trains have level boarding, so you can roll straight on from the platform.

Two things worth knowing:

- Not every station has a fare gate right where the elevator lets you out. If you can't get through, press the button on the courtesy phone by the elevator or go to the station agent's booth and they'll let you in or out.
- Elevators do go out of service sometimes. BART posts current elevator status at bart.gov/stations/elevators, so it's worth a check before a trip.

If you'd like, tell me where you're starting from and where you're headed and I can look at what services could get you there — including door-to-door options if BART isn't the easiest fit.
